{{Quote|Yinkle? That's a funny name.|Ledina Chott|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
'''Ledina Chott''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was a famous interplanetary pop singer who resided on [[Kuratooine]]. In [[44 ABY]], she had received various gifts from a mysterious man named Thadley Biolan, who was really known as corrupt [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]. Since Chott had physical similarities to all of Thaal's ex-wives, the General looked to Chott as a new mistress.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

During [[Wraith Squadron]]'s investigation into Thaal's guilt regarding his involvement with the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]], they deduced that, as Biolan, he would retire from the military service and probably pick Chott as a potential [[Marriage/Legends|wife]]. In response, one of the Wraiths, [[Trey Courser]], wore a double disguise of Biolan over Thaal and he and a few of the other Wraiths kidnapped her from her home and drugged her before Thaal himself could meet her.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

The next day, Courser and fellow Wraith [[Drikall Bessarah]] smuggled Chott's unconscious form to the Kuratooine warehouse where Thaal performed some of his criminal operations. From there, after the two Wraiths dealt with security, they activated Chott's emergency transponder so that the local [[Kura City Guard]] could save her; this way, Thaal could be framed for kidnapping Chott, though they weren't counting on him actually being convicted for their crime.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

==Personality and traits==
By the time she was kidnapped, Ledina Chott had been a pop star for about two [[Standard year|years]], yet she wasn't jaded and used to the life of a celebrity yet. She was also annoyed that her home on Kuratooine would feature holos and stills of her works only and not of works of some of the celebrities she liked. Her facial resemblance to the template that [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] loves made her a potential wife to him, which was why he sent her gifts as Thadley Biolan.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
